process_area.title: Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics

value_stream.name: Corporate Political Engagement, Election Compliance & Public Affairs Governance

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Legal (links to VS-100), regional teams, B2G Sales (links to VS-46), Corporate Communications (links to VS-14.3)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Govt Affairs manage engagements per the conduct standards" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report relationship health to leadership" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: single owner and CRM; operational: conduct standards
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inconsistent-engagement risk**: Multiple parties engaging officials inconsistently; mitigated by single owner and CRM
- **Conduct-breach risk**: Engagements crossing anti-graft lines; mitigated by conduct standards
System Touchpoints: - Govt affairs (links to VS-104); legal (links to VS-100); LGU (links to VS-76); B2G (links to VS-46); comms (links to VS-14.3); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs maintain the stakeholder/relationship map and CRM for political-engagement stakeholders (officials, regulators, LGUs links to VS-76, associations links to VS-104.2), with relationship owners, interaction history, and conduct compliance (links to W4037 anti-graft and W4038)
Govt Affairs manage engagements per the conduct standards (links to W4037) and the lobbying/advocacy registry (links to W4028), ensuring consistent, accountable, and documented interaction
Govt Affairs/Comms coordinate stakeholder messaging with corporate communications (links to VS-14.3) and brand/reputation (links to VS-25), and report relationship health to leadership

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Legal, Strategy (links to VS-33), affected business units, Compliance (links to VS-119), Corporate Communications (links to VS-14.3)
fields.Trigger: Policy consultation; legislative/regulatory proposal; advocacy opportunity

workflows.name: Public-Affairs Position Development, Submission & Advocacy Execution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-issue of "Govt Affairs/Legal develop BuildRight's position on material policy issues" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-submit of "Govt Affairs submit positions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Govt Affairs document submissions/advocacy" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: development process and Strategy alignment; operational: governance and controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Position-incoherence risk**: Inconsistent positions across issues/units; mitigated by development process and Strategy alignment
- **Advocacy-overreach risk**: Advocacy crossing into improper conduct; mitigated by governance and controls
System Touchpoints: - Govt affairs (links to VS-104); strategy (links to VS-33); legal (links to VS-100); competition (links to VS-129); records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs/Legal develop BuildRight's position on material policy issues (retail tax/e-invoicing, consumer, labor, customs/tariff, energy, data privacy, property) with affected business input and Strategy alignment (links to VS-33), ensuring the position is lawful, evidence-based, and within competition guardrails (links to VS-129 W3965)

Govt Affairs submit positions (consultation responses, position papers, testimony) and execute advocacy per the lobbying/advocacy governance (links to W4028), the association protocol (links to VS-129 W3965), and anti-graft controls (links to W4037)
Govt Affairs document submissions/advocacy (links to W4028/W4032), track outcomes, and report to leadership/Board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Legal, Insights (links to VS-44), Strategy (links to VS-33), Compliance, Internal Audit/Risk (links to VS-21.2)
fields.Trigger: Monitoring cycle; scenario need; risk register update

workflows.name: Political & Regulatory Risk Monitoring, Scenario & Exposure Analysis

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor political and regulatory developments" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-register of "Govt Affairs/Legal run scenario and exposure analysis" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: scenarios and contingency options; operational: integration with VS-21
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unpreparedness risk**: Material political/regulatory change unanticipated; mitigated by scenarios and contingency options
- **ERM-disconnect risk**: Political risk not in ERM; mitigated by integration with VS-21.2
System Touchpoints: - Govt affairs (links to VS-104); insights (links to VS-44); strategy (links to VS-33); ERM (links to VS-21.2); supply chain (links to VS-02/VS-87); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs/Insights monitor political and regulatory developments (links to W4040) and assess exposure and scenarios (election outcomes, policy shifts, enforcement priorities, geopolitical/trade impacts on supply chain links to VS-02/VS-87)

Govt Affairs/Legal run scenario and exposure analysis (likelihood/impact), feed material risks into the ERM risk register (links to VS-21.2) and strategy (links to VS-33), and develop mitigation/contingency options
Govt Affairs brief leadership and the Board (links to VS-36) on political/regulatory risk and scenarios, and refresh on change

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Legal, Compliance (links to VS-119), Sustainability (links to VS-25), affected business units, Strategy (links to VS-33)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Govt Affairs/Legal establish governance for BuildRight participation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Govt Affairs manage participation in-life, document positions/submissions" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: protocols (links to VS-129); operational: review and exit rights
Pain Points / Risks: - **Competition-risk**: Coalition crossing into concerted conduct; mitigated by protocols (links to VS-129)
- **Reputational-misalignment risk**: Initiative positions conflicting with BuildRight's; mitigated by review and exit rights
System Touchpoints: - Govt affairs (links to VS-104); competition (links to VS-129); ABC (links to VS-86); ESG (links to VS-25); legal (links to VS-100); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs/Legal assess coalition/multi-stakeholder initiative opportunities (industry coalitions, public-private partnerships, multi-stakeholder initiatives) for strategic fit, competition risk (links to VS-129 W3963/W3965), ABC exposure (links to VS-86), and reputational alignment

Govt Affairs/Legal establish governance for BuildRight participation: scope, BuildRight's role and positions, information-barrier/competition protocols (links to VS-129), and exit rights; integrate with association-membership review (W4029)
Govt Affairs manage participation in-life, document positions/submissions (links to W4028/W4032), and review continued participation periodically

fields.Participants: Legal (links to VS-100), Corporate Communications (links to VS-14.3), Compliance (links to VS-119), Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), ABC (links to VS-86), affected business unit, CEO, Board, external counsel/PR

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-activate of "activate crisis management on a political/reputational issue" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report to the Board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: readiness and crisis team; operational: crisis-comms coordination
Pain Points / Risks: - **Slow-response risk**: Crisis escalating before response; mitigated by readiness and crisis team
- **Inconsistent-messaging risk**: Mixed public messages; mitigated by crisis-comms coordination
System Touchpoints: - Legal/litigation (links to VS-100); comms/crisis (links to VS-14.3); ethics (links to VS-119); ABC (links to VS-86); audit (links to VS-21); governance (links to VS-36); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Legal/Comms activate crisis management on a political/reputational issue (allegation of prohibited contribution, anti-graft breach, partisan-activity allegation, official investigation): convene the crisis team, assess facts and exposure, and stabilize

Legal/Comms manage the response: investigation (links to VS-119/VS-21), legal/regulatory engagement (COMELEC/Ombudsman/BIR as relevant), communications (links to VS-14.3 crisis-comms), and stakeholder/investor/lender management
Legal/Compliance manage resolution, remediation (links to VS-119 W3724 remediation), lessons learned, and disclosure (links to W4032), and report to the Board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Internal Audit (links to VS-21.1), Legal, Compliance (links to VS-119), Finance (links to VS-17.4), external assurance
fields.Trigger: Audit plan (links to VS-21); risk-based trigger; cycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Internal Audit/Legal run periodic political-engagement compliance audits" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation and disclosure accuracy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track to closure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: periodic audit coverage; operational: tracking and Board oversight
Pain Points / Risks: - **Control-gap risk**: Undetected non-compliance; mitigated by periodic audit coverage
- **Finding-non-closure risk**: Issues not remediated; mitigated by tracking and Board oversight
System Touchpoints: - Audit (links to VS-21.1); legal (links to VS-100); ethics (links to VS-119); finance (links to VS-17.4); records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Internal Audit/Legal run periodic political-engagement compliance audits: contribution/donation controls (W4027/W4034), lobbying/advocacy governance (W4028), election-period compliance (W4033), anti-graft controls (W4037), revolving-door (W4038), and records/disclosure (W4032)
Internal Audit test control effectiveness, sample transactions/interactions, and verify documentation and disclosure accuracy; report findings
Legal/Compliance close findings, update controls, and track to closure (links to W4048)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Analytics (links to VS-28), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Legal, Compliance (links to VS-119)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile program analytics" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-measure of "measure ROI/effectiveness of govt-affairs and advocacy spend" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report analytics to leadership and the Board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: outcome analytics; operational: non-partisan framing
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unmeasured-activity risk**: Advocacy effectiveness unknown; mitigated by outcome analytics
- **ROI-misframing risk**: Spending framed as political rather than policy/advocacy; mitigated by non-partisan framing
System Touchpoints: - Analytics (links to VS-28); govt affairs (links to VS-104); finance (links to VS-17.4); governance (links to VS-36); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs/Analytics compile program analytics: advocacy outcomes/positions advanced, stakeholder engagement quality, political/regulatory risks mitigated, compliance audit results, disclosure completeness, spend vs budget, and incidents
Govt Affairs/Finance measure ROI/effectiveness of govt-affairs and advocacy spend (outcomes achieved, risk avoided) — within the constraints of non-partisanship and lawful engagement
Govt Affairs report analytics to leadership and the Board (links to VS-36), and iterate resourcing/approach

fields.Participants: VP Legal, Compliance (links to VS-119), Govt Affairs (links to VS-104), Internal Audit (links to VS-21), Strategy (links to VS-33), CEO, Board Audit/Risk Committee
fields.Trigger: Annual review; election-cycle close; regulatory change

workflows.name: Political-Engagement Program Review, Continuous Improvement & Board Oversight

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "VP Legal run the annual program review" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor regulatory developments" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture, incidents, and the forward plan" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-628 (ensure controlled execution — Stakeholder & Government Affairs Governance, Monitoring & Analytics (PA-132.3).)
- operational: structured reporting; operational: benchmarking and review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Board-blind-spot risk**: Political exposure under-reported; mitigated by structured reporting
- **Maturity-stagnation risk**: Program not improving; mitigated by benchmarking and review
System Touchpoints: - Governance (links to VS-36); audit/ERM (links to VS-21); govt affairs (links to VS-104); strategy (links to VS-33); records (links to VS-88); legal (links to VS-100)

steps.activity: VP Legal run the annual program review (policy currency W4025, control effectiveness W4046, analytics W4047, incident lessons W4045), benchmark against peer/good-practice, and identify improvements
VP Legal monitor regulatory developments (election law, anti-graft, lobbying/transparency expectations) and adjust the program (links to W4040); secure budget/resources

VP Legal/CEO report to the Board Audit/Risk Committee (links to VS-36/VS-21.2): program status, material risks/engagements, compliance posture, incidents, and the forward plan; seek direction on risk appetite
